name: toolkit
description: Small, focused Claude Code plugins for running file-based agent teams: onboarding an agent to a coordinator's inbox and outbox, the coordinator's briefing and decision queue, and read-only reviewer subagents.

plugins.name: agent-onboarding
plugins.description: Charter template, a /start-work skill and an .agent/ inbox-outbox setup for an agent that takes tasks from a coordinator agent.

plugins.name: coordinator
plugins.description: A read-only /briefing for the coordinator agent: every project agent's inbox and outbox since the last check-in, stalls, unclear threads, and a capped, deadline-ordered decision queue for the owner.

plugins.name: reviewers
plugins.description: Read-only reviewer subagents: fact-checker and editorial-reviewer return PASS, FAIL or ESCALATE on a diff; skill-reviewer vets a third-party skill at a pinned commit before install.
